WitchboardX v1.0.4 is a CPU hotfix for this separate plugin (NT Gallery identity `WtbX`, distinct from Witchboard `WtC1`). It supports up to 10 stereo channels, six insert routes, four shared stereo FX sends, per-channel timing offsets, trigger ducking, Main lookahead, Bypass Offset alignment, master filtering, JSON-backed names, and route-derived insert slot labels.

This build is the no-DRAM firmware-safe release for **disting NT v1.18 or later**.

Download **WitchboardX.zip** or **release.zip** for the plugin object only. No user preset or sample library is included. Copy `programs/plug-ins/WitchboardX.o` to the same path on the MicroSD card.

This hotfix release contains the plugin object only. It does not include any user preset or sample library.

Four-rate routing/DSP/preset tests, preset migration tests, ARM object build and object inspection run before packaging. Hardware audio and CPU use still need checking on the disting NT.
